t: Building a World for a Goldfish: How to Manage AI Context in VSCode
s: The article explores managing AI context in VSCode-based editors like Cursor, arguing that due to LLMs' 'goldfish memory,' developers must deliberately narrow their workspace to a single project to provide effective context for AI interactions.
sub: VSCode and its forks (Cursor, Windsurf) as AI defaults
Myopification: Narrowing workspace for AI focus
